_note: PRD v6 R3.3/R3.4 (replaces v5 R3): the designer's prompt (brand/designer_prompt.md, verbatim, original spelling) is the core of every non-Roman OpenRouter prompt, adapted per category (designerAdapt: platform and format). designer mode (the default): the model draws the whole ad with the exact German strings; image inputs = the colour section of the brand guide (guidelineCrop in config/brand_refs.json; never the type specimen or the logo specimen) and 2-3 approved references with their logos masked; never the logo file (2026-10-21: the model drew wordmarks after seeing it). The prompt carries no logo, wordmark or brand name outside its negatives (designer_prompt.check_brand_free) and keeps the logo corner plain dark space; the app places the real logo (and the website) afterwards and reads the text back once per attempt (textCheck): one regeneration, then composite mode (the failed scene reused under the panel when the layout allows it, else one composite generation). composite mode (the fallback, and always for Roman): the model draws only the scene with the text side dark and empty, with no image inputs; the app draws everything else (workflows/design_render.py). Zones are described in words only, never as coordinates (the v5 prompt printed 'x 6-34%' into the images). Placeholders: {platform} {category} {format} {size} {purpose} {mission} {topic} {variant} {layout} {picture} {look} {texts} {logoCorner} {textSide} {references} {referenceImages}.

designerAdapt.using Brandit Genius brand style guide a: using the brand style guide's colours and its dark-navy look; keep the side corner as plain empty dark space.
designerAdapt.It must match the motive and aim of Bran: It must match the motive and aim of the brand.

mission: AI automation that creates results: AI agents and workflows, AI chatbots, AI callbots, AI marketing and sales automation and AI workshops for companies in Germany (the verified services of config/services.json)
inputs: Attached inputs: image 1 is the colour section of the brand's style guide (use its colours; it is not a layout to copy). {referenceImages} approved ads of the same brand, with their corners masked; match their look: {references}.
brief: This is a {category} for {platform}. Purpose: {purpose}. It must match the motive and aim of the brand: {mission}. Topic: {topic}. Layout variant {variant}: {layout}. The visual: {picture}.

look.feed: The look, as in the approved references: a near-black, deep midnight-navy base with a subtle vignette and a soft blue glow; royal blue #004BA0 only as glow, thin lines and accents, never as a flat fill; text in a heavy geometric sans-serif, the headline in white capitals on three to five short lines with the marked keywords in light sky blue #69BFF8, the body in white sentence case; a rich photorealistic or 3D scene that fills the visual side (glowing holographic UI, connected rounded-square icon nodes with thin blue lines, an AI brain or chip, a phone with a chat, or an anonymous professional in a navy suit in a dark modern office), never an empty box; a few decorations only; the call to action as a wide rounded button with a dark fill, a glowing blue outline, white text and its icon kept clear of the text.
look.carousel: The look, as in the approved carousel slides: a pure black base, a small cyan dot grid in the upper left, thin glowing blue circle arcs touching the frame edges and a blue particle-wave mesh along the bottom; a bold geometric sans-serif headline in sentence case, left-aligned in the left half, white with the marked keywords in bright blue, optionally a short blue divider line; one visual on the right: neon blue line art, a glossy white 3D robot with glowing blue eyes, or a glowing chip; addressed with du; no slide number anywhere.

texts: Write exactly these German texts and nothing else, letter for letter with their umlauts, ß and punctuation, each in its place as described in the layout: {texts}.
negatives: Never write coordinates, percentages, zone names, sizes or any number that is not in these texts; no fake, garbled, placeholder or English text; no logos, no wordmarks, no brand names, no watermarks and no extra text beyond the given strings; no slide numbers or counters; no flat bright-blue fill and no light grey or white background; never copy the style guide's type specimen, colour swatches or headings.
format: Must be {format} ({size}); keep every text, the button and the empty corner well inside the frame, clear of the top and bottom edges, which may be trimmed.

composite.core: Create only the picture for a premium {category} on {platform}; the app adds all text, the buttons and the icons afterwards. {look} The visual: {picture}. {textSide} stays a calm, dark, empty midnight-navy area with no objects or light sources, so the text added later stays readable.
composite.negatives: No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, UI writing or slide numbers anywhere; no flat bright-blue fill and no light background.

textCheck._note: R3.4 text verification (2026-10-21): the image is read back once per attempt through OpenRouter with a vision chat model (model; gpt-image-2 only makes images) and compared with the intended strings (line breaks, line-end hyphenation and capitals normalised; umlauts, ß and spelling must match). It fails only for a wrong or missing headline/body/CTA, a logo or wordmark, or anything in the empty logo corner; small glyphs inside the illustration are allowed (reported as warnings). A service error (timeout, 429, 5xx, bad response) retries the check once and never counts as an image attempt. estimatedUsd is an estimate, not calibrated. attempts: designer attempts (the first and one regeneration) before composite mode.
textCheck.prompt: Transcribe every piece of text visible in this image exactly as written, including umlauts, ß, punctuation, capitalisation, small print, numbers and any text inside logos or interface elements. One text block per line, top to bottom. Do not translate, correct or add anything. If there is no text, answer NONE.

checks._note: R3.6 image checks (workflows/image_check.py), calibrated on the approved references (all pass) and tests/fixtures/rejected/ (all fail): base = median of the darkest 40% of the pixels.
